definitions.explanation: Describes how something appears or the manner in which something is done.
Used to make comparisons or indicate similarity.
Expresses purpose or aim when followed by に.

examples.english: It looks like it's going to rain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{怒|おこ}って→怒る：00876_okoru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧よう⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.notes: Appearance/seeming usage with ようです

examples.japanese: ⟦{天気予報|てんきよほう}→天気予報：01678_tenkiyohou⟧⟦によると→〜によると：03104_niyoruto⟧、⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}る→降る：00839_furu⟧よう⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: According to the weather forecast, it looks like it will snow tomorrow.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{走|はし}り→走る：00519_hashiru⟧⟦{回|まわ}った→回る：01150_mawaru⟧。
examples.english: I ran around like a child.
examples.notes: ～のように = like ~, in the manner of ~

examples.japanese: ⟦まるで→まるで：03739_marude⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The scenery was just like something out of a movie.
examples.notes: まるで～のような = just like ~

examples.japanese: ⟦{忘|わす}れない→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦メモ→メモ：00274_memo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I took notes so that I wouldn't forget.
examples.notes: ～ないように = so as not to ~

examples.japanese: ⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}して→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。

examples.japanese: ⟦{遅刻|ちこく}しない→遅刻：03465_chikoku⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|で}ました→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: I left home early so that I wouldn't be late.
examples.notes: ～ないように = so as not to ~

notes:
よう (sometimes written {様|よう}) is a grammatically versatile word with three main functions.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧よう⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧/⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧: it seems like ~, it appears to be ~ (conjecture)
- ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような + noun: a ~ -like noun (comparison)
- ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: like ~, in the manner of ~
- ～よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: so that ~, in order to ~ (purpose)
- ～よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make sure to ~, to try to ~
- ～よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to come to be able to ~, to reach a state where ~

USAGE:
- ⟦まるで→まるで：03739_marude⟧～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧よう strengthens the comparison: "just like ~"
- ～⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ expresses negative purpose: "so as not to ~"
- よう⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧ expresses soft conjecture based on evidence, softer than ⟦らしい→らしい：09502_rashii⟧

SIMILAR WORDS:
- よう: based on speaker's impression/evidence
- ⟦らしい→らしい：09502_rashii⟧: based on hearsay or external information
- ⟦みたい→みたい：10755_mitai⟧: casual equivalent of よう (more colloquial)

cross_references.label: also expresses conjecture; based on hearsay rather than direct evidence
